lemma path_split (h : R.Bounds c σ C Λ) (hw : Width p c σ) (hc : Decent c p) (α Δ : ℝ) (U : Config G n) :
    (α+Δ)* kinetic R c p U + (layer (fade R c p Δ) U + layer (upperFade R p α Δ) U) =
      α*layer (fun d : Low => d.maskedPlain R c 0 p) U + Δ*(∑ o, heads p o U) + layer (fun d : Low => d.loan R c 0 p α Δ) U := by

proof_context.conclusion: `(α+Δ)*kinetic` plus the low and high fades equals `α*layer maskedPlain + Δ*∑ heads + layer loan`: the high fades cancel the `(α+Δ)` summit term and the low terms are summed.

lemma exponent (hn : 20 < n.val) (β τ : ℝ) (U : Config G n) : let Δ := delta (X.read v)
    let t := branch X R c p v α; let Y := shelves X R p; let T := trunk R c p Y t (β+α+Δ) (vac v τ)
    T.exponent U + (∑' i, t.logarithm i U) = (frozen X R c p v β τ).exponent U - α*receipt R c p U := by
  intro Δ t Y T
  change vac v τ * sites n - R.inChannels c p (β+α+Δ) U - _ + _ = (τ*sites n - R.inChannels _ _ β U - _)-_
  rw [vac,sub_mul,div_mul_cancel₀ _ (sites_pos n).ne', channels_split U (β+α+Δ),channels_split U β]
  have hh := h.first_split g hn U
  have he := h.additive g hx α Δ U
  have ht := h.throw_sum g hx hc hw α Δ U
  have hz := path_split hx hw hc α Δ U
  dsimp only [T,trunk,t,Y,branch,receipt,frozen]
  dsimp [Δ] at *; linarith

proof_context.conclusion: The output exponent plus the sum of the logarithms equals the input exponent minus `α*receipt`.
